CONFIDENCE: 0.68
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches (2917, 2938, 2980, 3015 cm⁻¹; cf. GFQ-003) and lacks any clear carbonyl (~1700 cm⁻¹) or N–H stretch (~3300–3400 cm⁻¹), disfavoring candidates with C=O or NH. A distinctive triad consistent with a sulfone group is present: a strong band at 1336 cm⁻¹ (νas(SO₂)), a band at 1138 cm⁻¹ (νs(SO₂)), and a deformation near 539 cm⁻¹ (δ(SO₂)), which together point to an aryl/heteroaryl sulfone. Candidate 7 contains an SO₂ group and methyl substituents, aligning with the observed CH region and these sulfone signatures, whereas other candidates either contain carbonyls or NH groups that are not supported by the spectrum.
